supported_versions.runtime_protocol: operations spawn, observe, command, drain, terminate, recover; statuses ok, ambiguous, unavailable, unsupported, refused; recovery modes reattach, resume
supported_versions.backends: local (LocalHerdrRuntime over HerdrRuntime); remote backends are fixtures only

interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.runtime.base: Capability, Status, Recovery, SpawnRequest, Outcome, Runtime, foreign, RuntimeRouter (spawn, observe, command, drain, terminate, recover, spawn_backend, capability_failures_total, from_environ)
scripts.swarm_v2.runtime.local.LocalHerdrRuntime: compatibility adapter over scripts.swarm.runtime.HerdrRuntime spawn, observe, nudge, retire, refusal, recover and resume

scripts.swarm_v2.runtime.routed.RoutedRuntime and routed: the swarm tick and swarm stop call spawn, observe, nudge, retire and resume through RuntimeRouter; every other tick call stays on HerdrRuntime
scripts.swarm.tick.SpawnError carries a typed status (unsupported, unavailable, refused) set at each raise site
AGENTIHOOKS_RUNTIME_BACKEND selects the spawn backend, an unregistered one is unavailable and never falls back to local; AGENTIHOOKS_RUNTIME_DISABLED lists backends to disable

authority: Recorded as not applicable at this layer, pending acceptance: runtime operations carry no operator grant. Dispatch keys on the runtime_backend the router itself records at spawn, never on a display label; grants belong to the claims and fencing packages.

rollback_rehearsal.action: AGENTIHOOKS_RUNTIME_DISABLED=<backend> in the swarm tick environment routes new spawns to the local adapter; existing attempt records keep their runtime_backend and their operations return unavailable
rollback_rehearsal.case: c: a disabled remote left its attempt record and runtime object unchanged, a new spawn went local, and after re-enabling a replayed spawn reached only the owning remote, which returned the first object without a duplicate

remaining_limitations: Replay deduplication is the owning backend's: the router forwards a replayed spawn to its owner and adds no second backend; reconciliation by immutable execution ID (INV-R06) and generation fencing (INV-R07) are not implemented here.

Inspection calls (live names, bindings, conversations, pane naming, status, space close) still go to HerdrRuntime directly; every lifecycle call from the tick and the swarm CLI goes through RuntimeRouter. Process-level assumptions are SV2-RUN-02.
